name: print-social-white-list-it-get-paid-move-on-steps-slide-with-blue-left-rules
title: List It, Get Paid, Move On Steps Slide
whatItIs: A white slide with a blue tag 'HERE'S HOW IT WORKS', a huge black heavy 'LIST IT. GET PAID. MOVE ON.' and seven pale rounded rows each with a blue left rule, holding one short step in regular text with bold key words and a final italic grey 'Nobody loses.'
whatItMeans: Three verbs as a headline and a stack of one-line steps turn a process into something you can read in seconds.
techniques: Rows with a blue left border for steps
Bold key words in each step
Italic grey last line as a soft close

vocabulary.definition: A row marked by a coloured line on its left edge.
A headline made of short action phrases.
A quiet final line that wraps up a list.
